concerns.text: FR-001 and SC-001 require calculating the percentage of loaded variables and writing it to `data/results/variable_load_metrics.json` before halting. T012 is marked [ ] (pending) and T013 depends on it. Without these tasks completed, the system cannot satisfy the 'Dataset-variable fit' check or the SC-001 traceability requirement.

FR-001 (Edge Cases) and US1 require outlier exclusion and generation of `data/processed/filtered_data.parquet`. T014b is marked [ ] (pending). All downstream US2/US3 tasks (T020-T035) depend on this artifact. Its absence blocks the entire analysis pipeline.

Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) requires a manifest for synthetic data. T006d (schema definition) and T006c (manifest generation) are marked [ ] (pending). Without these, the synthetic data path lacks the required chain-of-custody/reproducibility artifacts defined in the plan.

FR-006 requires dynamic detection of 'Perfect Multicollinearity' via matrix rank check on the actual data. T021h (dynamic check) is marked [ ] (pending). T031 depends on merging T021f (static) and T021h. Without T021h, the dynamic collinearity requirement is unmet.

FR-004 requires explicit prohibition of causal language in the final report. T026a (`enforce_associational_framing`) is marked [ ] (pending). T026 (Report Generation) depends on T026a. Without this task, the report cannot satisfy FR-004.

The plan requires a strict 'No-Synthetic-Fallback' gate and real-data verification. T051a (fetch implementation), T055 (gate), and T056 (verification) are marked [ ] (pending). Without these, the project cannot enforce the 'Pipeline Validation Study' scope or prevent fabrication if real data is requested.

FR-007 and Assumption-001 require handling large datasets via streaming or fail-fast. T058 (RAM check), T059 (streaming), and T060 (fail-fast) are marked [ ] (pending). Without these, the pipeline cannot guarantee execution within 6 hours on standard runners for large inputs.

The 'Pipeline Validation Study' scope requires specific documentation and code updates to handle the synthetic-only state. T073 (Constitution Checker update) and T074 (Report Disclaimer) are marked [ ] (pending). Without these, the project cannot pass the final validation for the synthetic scope.
